title: Mobile In-Home Collection Charges in Reference-Testing Self-Pay Estimates
content:
When the specimen of a self-pay Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Esoteric Reference Testing class was collected in the home, collection-service fees of that visit are added to the reference-testing self-pay estimate. The visit concerned is the collected visit recorded for the accession with Specimen Collection Appointments.

**Clause.**

- **Mobile In-Home Collection Visit, no additional household patient.** When the visit served no additional household patient, the visit's assessed collection-service fees, net of any waived amount, are added to the estimate.
- **Mobile In-Home Collection Visit with additional household patients.** When the visit also served additional household patients, the visit's assessed trip fee and weekend surcharge, net of any waived amount, are divided equally among the patient and the additional household patients, and that share is added to the estimate. The additional-patient fee belongs to the household members.
- **Any other collection.** A specimen collected any other way adds no collection-service fee to the estimate.

| How the specimen was collected | Added to the estimate |
|---|---|
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit, no additional household patient | All assessed collection-service fees of the visit, less any waived amount |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit, one or more additional household patients | Trip fee plus weekend surcharge assessed, less any of those waived, divided by the number of patients collected (the patient plus the additional household patients) |
| Any other way | nothing |

**Worked figures (hypothetical fees).**

- A home visit for the patient alone, with a trip fee of 60.00 and a weekend surcharge of 30.00 assessed, and 10.00 waived: 80.00 added.
- The same visit also serving two additional household patients, nothing waived: 60.00 plus 30.00 is 90.00, divided among three patients gives 30.00 added. Any additional-patient fee on that visit is not part of the share.
- A Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment: nothing added.
